prompt: Use math-course-studio to review this proposed source statement for a future L09 exercise: over all humans, there exists x such that for every human y, age(x) > age(y). The source labels it true. Can we use it as a correct answer? Give the mathematical finding, any uncertainty about the original PDF, and an authoring recommendation. Write a draft review note; do not change published content.
expect: Flags y=x makes strict inequality false over a nonempty domain
Does not silently exclude self or certify a unique oldest human
Does not claim PDF inspection without access; reports discrepancy and holds authoring
